content_sections.heading: MEA Consultant Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available – 2 for the Consultant (Legal Cell) post.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Consultant (Legal Cell): LLB/B.L (5 year or 3 year course) from a recognised institute in India with good academic records. Preference for Masters in Law and experience as an advocate. At least 5 years of work experience post enrollment as an advocate. Proficiency in computers. Working experience with the Government Ministry/Department or PSU as legal advisor, having knowledge/experience of litigations in such Ministry or Department or PSU will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 25 years Maximum Age: 55 years

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Maximum of Rs. 12,00,000 per annum each, subject to deduction of applicable taxes.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Review of applications Shortlisting of candidates for interview / written test Interview / Written Test

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MEA Consultant (Legal Cell) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 19-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MEA Consultant (Legal Cell) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 19-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant (Legal Cell) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an LLB/B.L (5 year or 3 year course) from a recognized institute in India with good academic records. A Master's in Law and experience as an advocate are preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 25 years, and the maximum age limit is 55 years for the Consultant (Legal Cell) position.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant (Legal Cell) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Consultant (Legal Cell) position in the Ministry of External Affairs.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Consultant (Legal Cell) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a maximum salary of Rs. 12,00,000 per annum, subject to applicable tax deductions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications can be submitted via email to the designated address provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The engagement for the Consultant (Legal Cell) position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is Q/PF/575/29/2026.

faq.question: Q9. Does the MEA offer any age relaxation for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such information.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with their application.
